questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All tractors are cars.

Some scooters are cars.

All scooters are cycles.

**Conclusions:**

I. All scooters are cars.

II. Some cars are cycles.

III. Some tractors are cycles.

IV. Some tractors are scooters

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
**Statements:**

All tractors are cars.

Some scooters are cars.

All scooters are cycles.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75a508714e64b21437edb1700ede77e0648b2e45cf49129c662c348bacca1bf6.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All scooters are cars → False (It is possible but not definite)

II. Some cars are cycles → True (because Some scooters are cars and all scooters are cycles so, definitely Some cars are cycles)

III. Some tractors are cycles → False (It is possible but not definite)

IV. Some tractors are scooters → False (It is possible but not definite)

Hence, **Only conclusion II follow.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question:
Guna is the son of Shyamala. Hemanth is the father of Manu. Guna is married to Deepa. Guna and Manu are siblings. Prathik is the brother of Deepa. Shyamala has only one son. Roshan is the son of Guna. Prathik is the father of Kalki. Jatin is the son of Manu. Prathik has no daughters.

How is Hemanth related to Roshan's father?
questions.solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4cdd0b30cffaf954e65ff899730e11e9e4ceb2b8a3106f0f1cf7dc6cc2718c84.png] 

We can dram following Family Tree from the information given above:

1) Guna is the son of Shyamala.

2) Guna is married to Deepa.

3) Guna and Manu are siblings.

4) Hemanth is the father of Manu.

5) Prathik is the brother of Deepa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/434901ced3a8800e7782798f8f72a0254eb23b0abe854727458dc95800f2bb4d.png] 

6) Shyamala has only one son and Guna is the son of Shyamala **so Manu will be the daughter of Hemanth and Shymala.**

7) Roshan is the son of Guna.

8) Prathik is the father of Kalki and Prathik has no daughters. **So Kalki will be the son of Prathik.**

9) Jatin is the son of Manu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f16d21fef30db6058d332dd1b931f9ae474bd63a741045ee34f4740e711487f3.png] 

Thus, Hemanth is the father of Guna and Roshan is the son of Guna so Hemanth will be the grandfather of Roshan or Father of Roshan's father (i.e. Guna's father)

Hence, Hemanth is the **'father'** of Roshan's father.
